title: Respect!, exhibition design
excerpt: Exhibition design with light and interaction for Respect! Perspectieven in de hedendaagse kunst, at Museum De Voorde in Zoetermeer.
description:
Respect! Perspectieven in de hedendaagse kunst ran at Museum De Voorde in Zoetermeer from 5 February to 2 October 2022. I made the exhibition design, with light and interaction carrying the route through the rooms rather than sitting on top of the work.
> Designing an exhibition is deciding what a visitor meets first, and what they are still carrying when they reach the last room. Light does that quietly: it sets the order in which things are seen.
credits: Exhibition design, light and interaction: Jaco Schilp. Respect! Perspectieven in de hedendaagse kunst, Museum De Voorde, Zoetermeer, 5 February to 2 October 2022.
